name: Command Palette
summary: Modal command surface composed from canonical Modal plus an editable Combobox, named grouped Listbox, active-descendant command options, visible dismissal, empty status, and target-owned filtering/execution.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal overlay that owns backdrop, visibility state, modality, and vertical placement.

anatomy.name: panel
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal panel containing search and results.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible or visually hidden title that provides the dialog accessible name.

anatomy.name: inputWrapper
anatomy.description: Header row containing the search icon and input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Text input used to filter commands.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Visible canonical Close Button that dismisses the modal command surface.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Named result group that owns related command options.

anatomy.name: itemIcon
anatomy.description: Optional leading icon for a command.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Optional pre-existing polite status used for important empty or result changes.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional footer with usage hints or secondary metadata.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default panel width and result height.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible overlay state controlled by command-palette--open.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a command.

states.name: itemDisabled
states.description: Unavailable command option that remains perceivable but cannot execute.

states.name: empty
states.description: Visible no-results state with optional polite status announcement.

states.name: inputFocus
states.description: Focus treatment around the active search row.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The command palette is hidden by default and becomes visible when command-palette--open is applied.

behavior.name: overlaySemantics
behavior.description: The panel composes canonical Modal and must implement actual modality, a stable accessible name, visible Close Button, focus containment, dismissal, and restoration.

behavior.name: searchSemantics
behavior.description: The named editable search input retains DOM focus and exposes its relationship to the active command Listbox option.

behavior.name: resultSemantics
behavior.description: The named Listbox contains named groups and flat command options that are excluded from the page Tab sequence and contain no nested interactive controls.

behavior.name: focusLifecycle
behavior.description: Opening focuses search, modal controls contain Tab, and every close path restores the invoking or logical prior focus.

behavior.name: keyboardShortcuts
behavior.description: A target-scoped shortcut may open the palette; arrows/Home/End navigate enabled options, Enter executes, and Escape closes without overriding native text editing.

behavior.name: filtering
behavior.description: Typing filters commands while preserving text input composition behavior.

behavior.name: highlightedItem
behavior.description: Exactly one command should be highlighted when keyboard navigation is active.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the command palette overlay is visible; shortcut handling and focus management remain target behavior.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Current search query rendered in the command input; filtering remains target behavior.

accessibility: Compose the accepted Modal and Close Button implementations; block outside interaction only when aria-modal is true.
Focus the named search input on open, contain Tab among modal controls, and restore the invoking or logical prior focus on every close path.
Keep DOM focus in the Combobox while aria-activedescendant references one enabled Listbox option; options remain outside the page Tab sequence.
Support ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End and Enter without overriding native text editing or partial IME composition.
Do not place nested interactive controls inside a command option; disabled options never execute.
Provide visible empty feedback and announce important dynamic result changes without excessive per-keystroke speech.

web.notes: Implemented by canonical Modal/Close Button class composition plus command-specific search/result CSS; targets provide shortcut scope, filtering, active-descendant focus, announcements, command execution, modality and restoration.
